beats.say: Star Wars was released in 1977 as the fourth chronological chapter.
When the first film hit cinemas, it was simply called Star Wars without a number.
The story only officially became Episode 4 during a cinema reissue in 1981.
At that point, the subtitle A New Hope was added to the opening crawl.
The original trilogy then continued with Episodes 5 and 6 in 1980 and 1983.
Because the story began in the middle of a larger saga, prequels and sequels were later added to fill the gaps.
This means you start with the fourth part because the creator built the world from the centre out.

facts: Star Wars was released in 1977 as the fourth chronological chapter of the Skywalker Saga.
The 1981 reissue gave the film the subtitle Episode IV A New Hope.
The original trilogy follows Star Wars with Episodes V and VI released in 1980 and 1983.
Later, a prequel and a sequel trilogy were added to the saga.
